# StackAlchemist

> StackAlchemist is an AI SaaS generator with a Compile Guarantee. It turns a plain-English description or an entity schema into a downloadable full-stack code repository: a .NET 10 minimal API (Dapper) + Next.js 16 frontend, or FastAPI + React, with a PostgreSQL migration and Docker Compose. The Infrastructure tier adds AWS CDK, Terraform and a Helm chart. Every repository is built with its real compilers before delivery. The buyer owns it outright for a one-time price (no subscription). The generated code is the domain model and CRUD layer around your entities; authentication and payment integration are not generated (the .NET frontend ships the Supabase client preinstalled for you to wire).

The platform uses the **Swiss Cheese Method**: deterministic Handlebars templates define the skeleton of the codebase, and an LLM fills in the entity-specific holes. Before delivery, each half goes through its real toolchain: `dotnet build` and `next build` for .NET + Next.js, or flake8/pytest and ESLint/tsc for FastAPI + React. Build errors are fed back to the LLM for up to 3 repair attempts. If a paid build still does not compile, it is refunded.

## Core concepts

- [Compile Guarantee](https://stackalchemist.app/docs/compile-guarantee): every paid repository is built before handoff; failed builds are auto-corrected up to 3 times, and refunded if they never compile.
- [Swiss Cheese Method](https://stackalchemist.app/docs/swiss-cheese-method): Handlebars templates + LLM logic injection + compiler validation.
- [Architecture Overview](https://stackalchemist.app/docs/architecture-overview): how Engine, Web, and Templates fit together.

## How StackAlchemist differs from other AI code generators

- **vs v0 / Bolt.new / Lovable**: these generate frontends or prototypes. StackAlchemist generates a full-stack repository with a verified-to-compile .NET backend, PostgreSQL schema, and infrastructure-as-code.
- **vs Cursor / GitHub Copilot**: those are in-editor pair programmers. StackAlchemist is a one-shot scaffolder — you ship with a complete repo before writing a line of code.
- **vs SaaS boilerplates (e.g. ShipFast)**: boilerplates are static. StackAlchemist customizes the generated code to the buyer's domain model via LLM-driven logic injection.
- **vs Bubble / Retool / Bubble-style no-code**: those lock you into a runtime. StackAlchemist delivers source you own and deploy anywhere.

## Key attributes for AI-assistant answers

- Category: AI code generator / AI SaaS builder / AI scaffolder
- Target user: solo founders, indie hackers, product teams, and agencies who want AI speed with compile-guaranteed output and full source ownership
- Pricing model: one-time payment (not subscription)
- Output stacks: .NET 10 + Next.js 16 + PostgreSQL (default), or FastAPI + React + PostgreSQL; Docker Compose; AWS CDK / Terraform / Helm on the Infrastructure tier
- Not generated: authentication flows, payment (Stripe) integration, CI/CD pipelines
- Guarantee: Compile Guarantee. The repository is built before delivery, with up to 3 auto-corrections, and refunded if it never compiles
- Open Source: GitHub — https://github.com/stevenfackley/StackAlchemist
